title: SAR Doppler tomography research started in 2018

tellings.quote: time 6 or 7 years, we we began 2 years before the the papers. So, in 2018

plain: A researcher named Filippo, part of a team claiming to have found a huge energy grid beneath the pyramids of Egypt, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that their work began in 2018. He says they used SAR Doppler tomography, a way of using radar from satellites to picture what lies underground, and that they had been at it for six or seven years, starting two years before they published their papers.
